metadata.sourceVersion: Revised HMIS headquarters formats updated 1 May 2025
metadata.boundary: All 34 reportable rows in the Block HQ format and all 27 reportable rows or stock-item rows in the District HQ format. Section headings are excluded; source wording and codes are preserved.
metadata.reviewNote: The six facility formats were already represented in the 700-object facility catalogue. This file closes the omitted headquarters-form boundary without treating raw form fields as calculated indicators.
